scripts.sdlc:serve: npm run sdlc:serve → `concurrently 'node --import tsx server/index.ts' 'vite'` (single port 3000 via Fastify proxying to Vite in dev; prod serves the built bundle directly)
scripts.sdlc:seed: npm run sdlc:seed → `node --import tsx bin/seed.ts` — writes a deterministic fake business, fake account, 90 days of simulated events into SQLite
scripts.sdlc:ready: npm run sdlc:ready → `curl -sf http://localhost:3000/healthz` (returns 200 once the DB is migrated and the simulator is loaded)
